evidence_span: The analytical and numerical predictions of the self-diffusion coefficients as functions of solids fraction and coefficient of restitution are reasonably close to each other

The analytical and numerical predictions of the self-diffusion coefficients as functions of solids fraction and coefficient of restitution are reasonably close to each other and similar to the few laboratory experiments that exist.

It is worth mentioning that Chapman and Cowling (1970) have pointed out similar discrepancies for the case of dense fluids in which experimental measurements were higher than kinetic theories predictions.
